Name: Barzillai the Gileadite
Summary: Barzillai the Gileadite, a very aged and wealthy man of Rogelim, brought beds, basins, wheat, barley, and food to David and his exhausted people at Mahanaim during Absalom's revolt. He refused David's invitation to Jerusalem and asked only that Chimham go in his place.
KeyStory: Barzillai fed a fleeing king at Mahanaim and asked nothing for himself in return.
KeyVerses: 2 Samuel 17:27; 2 Samuel 19:32; 2 Samuel 19:34; 2 Samuel 19:37; 1 Kings 2:7; Ezra 2:61; Nehemiah 7:63
RelatedPeople: King David; Chimham; King Solomon; Barzillai
LifeLesson: Generosity in a king's darkest hour, asking nothing back, is remembered for generations.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile
